relationships.subject: ginsenoside Rg1
relationships.evidence_quote: Further investigation revealed that ginsenoside Rg1 significantly inhibited the expression of YAP1/TAZ signaling pathway-related proteins.

key_findings: Ginsenoside Rg1 raised pain thresholds and reduced inflammation, ECM degradation and apoptosis in IDD rats.
Effects mediated by suppression of YAP1/TAZ signaling.
